.github/workflows/ci.yml.note: Real incident, commit ac632a3 on this repo: a CI smoke-test step in ci.yml assumed GS2's old bd_id-resolvable shape while a DIFFERENT, correctly scope-locked agent migrated eval/scenarios/golden.json to a {bd} placeholder (bd_id: null) under its own Files -- neither agent's Scope Contract Files overlapped (one owned ci.yml, the other owned golden.json), so plain path-ownership alone never saw the conflict; CI only caught it after the fact (run 34214264970 red, fixed same day). Declaring the coupling here means `scope-check.sh ... ci.yml --verify` also reports CONFLICT if golden.json drifted since Dave#1's snapshot, even though Dave#1 only touches ci.yml.

Makefile.note: zip file-list edits collide easily across parallel milestones (each one appends its own new shipped path) -- route through one owner per engagement instead of two agents racing an append.

.preload-budget.note: every agent that adds a new agents/*.md baseline appends its own line -- concurrent appends are safe by construction, no single owner needed.
